svg.title: Virginia and D.C. sue to block Trump's planned arch
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration: the proposed 250-foot arch at Memorial Circle, which has not been built, is drawn as a glowing, dashed blueprint outline topped by a winged Lady Liberty holding a torch. It towers over the low granite arches of Arlington Memorial Bridge, the Potomac River, and the Lincoln Memorial and Washington Monument across the water, with ordinary cars on the traffic circle. In the foreground two generic figures in suits, standing for the Virginia and D.C. attorneys general, hold up a thick red-bound legal complaint toward it. No text.
